outlook.statement: The Company has taken significant steps to reduce costs in line with the projected sales. Further the Company is expected to deliver better business performance in coming quarters. During 2025-2026, it showed considerable recovery in demand and business results. Further it is expected to show also progressive recovery of demand and underlying business results.

General outlook for the company for the year 2025-2026. The turnover of the company for the year ended 2026 is Rs. 1372.80 lakhs whereas for the year ended 2025 Rs. 1388.59 lakhs. However, the Company has made profit of Rs. 31.90 lakhs as compared to previous year profit of Rs. 36.23 lakhs.
The Management is looking forward for better opportunities to be carried out in the Maharashtra factory.
